query: SELECT 'total' as label, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tool_usage_events UNION ALL SELECT 'today' as label, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tool_usage_events WHERE createdAt >= CURDATE() UNION ALL SELECT 'yesterday' as label, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tool_usage_events WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND createdAt < CURDATE();
